backfill_note: The post was published 2026-06-22. Its original raw harness scripts were not preserved (only the recorded experiment log survived). run.sh + probe.py here are a FAITHFUL RECONSTRUCTION of that experiment, and were freshly re-executed on 2026-08-12 against the same pinned builds on the same class of host (Windows, CP949). The committed probe-result.json is that fresh re-run and reproduces every recorded observation (EXP1/EXP2/EXP7/EXP8/EXP9). This is verification evidence, not a paper claim.
note: This is a default-text-encoding contract check, not a timing benchmark. The result depends on the CPython build and the host ANSI codepage, NOT on CPU/GPU/RAM, so hardware is intentionally omitted. On a UTF-8 host locale the contrast vanishes (both builds default to UTF-8) — that dependence is the point.

environment.runner: run.sh downloads two pinned python.org embeddable builds and runs probe.py under each

subject.name: cpython-embeddable-amd64
subject.release_note: 3.15 is the first line to default utf8_mode ON (PEP 686). 3.15.0b2 is a beta; final 3.15.0 was scheduled for 2026-10.

baseline.name: cpython-embeddable-amd64
baseline.release_note: Current stable line at run time; utf8_mode OFF by default (locale-derived text encoding = CP949 on this host).

cited_not_measured.final_3_15_0: Measured on 3.15.0b2 (beta). Behavior of the final 3.15.0 release is expected identical for PEP 686 but is cited, not measured here.
cited_not_measured.full_installer_store_builds: Measured on the embeddable amd64 distribution. The full installer / Microsoft Store 'site' configuration differs in packaging but not in the default text-encoding contract; not separately measured.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: none — this run has no large raw artifacts
raw_artifacts.note: run.sh downloads the two embeddable zips into a temp dir and deletes them on exit; they are pinned by URL, not committed. The deterministic evidence (probe-result.json) is small and committed. See checksums.txt for integrity hashes of the committed harness + evidence.
